CARD CATH
Cardiac Catheterization Report

Date of Birth: 8/4/1959   Gender: MALE
Height: 72(in)  Weight: 239.7(lb) BSA: 2.29
Procedure Date: 6/29/2026  Procedure Number: ACCHM000670
Cath Physician: Ullah, Waqas MD
Referring Physician: Gotimer, Patrick MD

History of Present Illness: 66 year old male presenting with anterolateral STEMI

The risks, benefits and alternatives of procedure were explained to the patient and
appropriate consent was obtained. The procedure was done in the Cath Lab under aseptic
technique using Lidocaine local anesthetic, appropriate guide wire, catheters, sheaths and
dilators. Following the procedure, the sheath(s) was/were removed and hemostasis was
obtained. Moderate sedation was given by interventional cardiologist and monitored by
trained independent observers for the duration of the procedure (including the first 15
minutes).

Procedure Name: Acute MI PCI, Coronary PTCA (initial), IVUS/OCT (initial), IVUS/OCT (addl)

ACCESS SITE: Sheath was inserted into the RIGHT radial artery

Left Main: No significant coronary artery disease.
LAD: 20% Mid lesion in LAD; 100% Mid lesion in DIAG1
Circumflex: 100% Mid lesion in OM 1
Right: No significant coronary artery disease.

LV FINDINGS: Elevated EDP pre angio
VALVE FINDINGS: No aortic stenosis

INTERVENTION:
Lesion Site #1 - First diagonal branch segment - 1st Diag. Pre stenosis 100%, post stenosis
20%. PRE TIMI flow 0, POST TIMI flow 2.
Lesion Site #2 - First obtuse marginal branch segment - 1st OM. Pre stenosis 100%, post
stenosis 20%. PRE TIMI flow 0, POST TIMI flow 2.

Estimated Total Blood Loss: 5 mL's
Complications: No Complications

Impression:
Total thrombotic occlusion of the D1 and OM1 causing STEMI that is anterolateral.
6F, Right radial access. EBU 3.75 6F guide, Runthrough wire. IVUS showing thrombus in both
vessels but minimal D1 plaque only with reference vessel diameter of 2.5mm.
Severe mid D1 stenosis s/p IVUS guided 2.0mm compliant balloon angioplasty, 2.25mm NC
balloon angioplasty followed by 2.5x12mm XIENCE stent placement. PTCA of OM with 2mm
balloon. Good final angiographic results with TIMI 2 flow.

Recommendation:
Integrilin for 6 hours
TR band wean as per protocol
Monitor vitals, rhythm and vascular access site
Follow up with cardiology
Aggressive risk factor modification
Aspirin, ticagrelor and high intensity statin
Echo and potential TEE for ruling out clot and cardioembolic phenomena, also consider
hypercoagulable work up

Disposition:
The patient will be returned to their room after the procedure, following bedrest and
subsequent ambulation, provided the recovery parameters are appropriate.
The patient has been instructed to call the procedural cardiologist immediately if symptoms
recur.
